    digits = "".join(c for c in amount_str.decode("ascii", "replace")

    digits = "".join(c for c in amount_str.decode("ascii", "replace")
                     if c.isdigit())
    cleaned = (" " * 10 + digits)[-10:]
    amount = int(cleaned) if cleaned.strip() != "" else 0'''
assert old in src
open('program.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
print("patched")
EOF
